subject: SIG evidence and delivery schedule for NexaWorks integration
messages:
From: Jared Cole <jared.cole@nexaworks.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@nexaworks.com
Date: 2027-03-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: SIG evidence & timing for NexaWorks integration

Hi Rishi,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — NexaWorks is excited to move the integration forward. Our security and procurement teams have a SIG questionnaire in flight and we need the following artifacts to finish the review:

- Latest SOC 2 Type II report (covering infrastructure & SaaS controls)
- Executive summary of the most recent third-party penetration test (scope and critical/medium findings)
- ISO/IEC 27001 statement or certificate (if available)
- A short security overview deck (arch diagram + data flow + retention)

Can you confirm what you can share as downloadable artifacts versus items that need an NDAs/secure portal? Also looking for an ETA — target is to complete the SIG by end of next week (2027-03-26).

Would you have 20–30 minutes for a quick sync on Friday (Mar 19) so we can run through any gaps?

Thanks,
Jared
Jared Cole
Head of IT Risk, NexaWorks
jared.cole@nexaworks.com
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Jared Cole <jared.cole@nexaworks.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-03-15T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG evidence & timing for NexaWorks integration

Jared — thanks, great to hear NexaWorks is moving ahead.

Quick summary of what we can provide and suggested delivery approach:

- SOC 2 Type II report (Redacted): we can provide a redacted PDF via our secure share link.
- Pen test: we have a vendor summary (exec summary) that we can share; full report requires a disclosure agreement in rare cases — the summary will include scope, dates, and remediation status.
- ISO statement: Redwood maintains an ISO27001 statement of applicability; we can provide the attestation document.
- Security deck: happy to share the latest deck (we keep a short architecture page for third parties).

Proposed timeline:
- Fri 2027-03-19: share SOC2 (redacted) + security deck via secure share; send pen test exec summary the same day if available.
- Mon 2027-03-22: follow-up with ISO statement and any clarifying notes.

Action items (internal):
- Marissa: prepare SOC2 redacted copy + security deck (slides) and upload to secure share.
- Karthik: confirm pen test summary text and redact any vuln details that aren't cleared for distribution.
- Monica: be on the Mar 19 sync for any product/architecture Qs.

If that works for you Jared, I’ll send the secure share link on Friday morning and block 30 minutes on Mar 19 10:00 PT.

Rishi Malhotra
Director, Platform Security
Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jared Cole <jared.cole@nexaworks.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-19T08:32:00-07:00
Subject: Deliverables for NexaWorks SIG (SOC2 + deck)

Hi Jared,

Per Rishi’s plan I’ve uploaded the initial artifacts to our secure share (link below). Attached are the two files we expect to be immediately useful:

Attachments:
- SOC2_report_Redwood_2026.pdf (redacted, PDF)
- security_deck_redwood_v4.pptx (pptx)

Secure share: https://secure-share.redwood.ai/s/abcd1234 (expires 2027-03-25)

Notes: the SOC 2 PDF has operational control descriptions redacted for customer-specific configurations; if NexaWorks needs a more detailed readout we can arrange an auditor-attested review under an NDA. The deck includes a one-slide logical architecture and data flow; let me know if you need a more detailed diagram.

I’ll attach the pen test exec summary once karthik confirms the final redactions (expected EOD today).

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Security Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
From: Jared Cole <jared.cole@nexaworks.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, procurement@nexaworks.com
Date: 2027-03-19T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Deliverables for NexaWorks SIG (SOC2 + deck)

Thanks Marissa — received the link and the two files. A couple of clarifying questions before the sync:

- Pen test: can you confirm the testing window (month/year) and whether the tests included external black-box and authenticated scans? We need to note the scope on the SIG form.
- ISO: is the statement you mentioned a certificate (signed) or a self-attestation? If certified, could you include the certification body name and date?
- Architecture: the deck slide is helpful; for our internal risk assessment we need a diagram that includes network segmentation and where Redis/KV caching is hosted (managed vs customer).

If you can add these notes to the secure share prior to our call, we’ll be able to close most items during the sync.

On timing: 10:00 PT today still works — joining shortly.

Best,
Jared
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Jared Cole <jared.cole@nexaworks.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-18T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG evidence & timing for NexaWorks integration

Jared — quick update following Marissa and Karthik’s checks: we’ll add the following to the secure share by EOD today (links above):

- pen_test_summary_2026.pdf (exec summary; testing window: 2026-09; includes external black-box + authenticated scans; criticals were remediated and re-verified)
- ISO27001_statement_2026.txt (attestation; certified through audit by CertSure LLC, certified 2025-11, current scope covers Redwood cloud-hosted service)

We’ll also drop an expanded architecture slide that highlights caching location (managed Redis in our VPC for hosted customers; private deployments are customer-managed) and network segmentation notes.

Call confirmed: Mar 19, 10:00 PT — Monica will lead any product-level walkthroughs, Marissa will run the security artifacts, and I’ll be available for risk questions.

Link to HubSpot deal for reference: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/DEAL-NX-2027-11

Looking forward to the call — we should be able to close the SIG by 2027-03-25 given this schedule.

Cheers,
Rishi
(Note: attachments referenced above are stubs — full files available via the secure share URL.)
